offering_description.value: Carter’s sells clothing, sleepwear, accessories, and baby gear to families and retail chains. It designs and sources products from contract manufacturers and sells them through its stores, websites, and retail partners.

primary_products.value: Baby and toddler clothing; older children’s clothing; children’s sleepwear; clothing accessories; baby gear

customer_segment.value: B2C: Parents, caregivers, and gift buyers; B2B: Mass merchants, department stores, specialty retailers, and online retailers

end_markets.value: Baby and children’s apparel; baby and nursery products

revenue_model.value: product sales: Apparel, accessories, and baby gear sold at retail and wholesale; licensing or royalties: Use of its brands in selected product categories and international markets

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: Designs apparel and baby products, sources them from contract manufacturers, and sells them to families and retailers; retailer: Sells its branded apparel and baby products directly to families through stores and websites

geography_served.value: global: Direct operations in the United States, Canada, and Mexico, with wholesale and licensing partners in other markets

specialization.value: related lines: Baby and children’s clothing, sleepwear, accessories, and baby gear

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated children’s apparel stores and outlets; online: Company e-commerce sites and online retailers; direct sales: Wholesale accounts with major retailers; third-party retail: Mass merchants, department stores, and specialty retailers; partners / resellers: International wholesale and licensing partners
distribution_channels.category: own locations; online; direct sales; third-party retail; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission rules on children’s product testing, apparel flammability, and sleepwear safety
